name: java-kernel
description: Installs a Java Jupyter kernel (IJava) from release or submodule and registers kernelspec.

KERNEL_VERSION.description: Kernel release version to download when using 'release' source (e.g. v1.4.6-pr12)

ARTIFACTS_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for release artefacts (e.g. GitHub releases base)

postInstallCheck.command:
bash -lc 'jupyter kernelspec list --json > /tmp/solen-java-kernelspecs.json && python - <<PY
import json, os
with open("/tmp/solen-java-kernelspecs.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    ks = json.load(f).get("kernelspecs", {})
spec = ks.get("java")
assert spec, "java kernelspec missing"
argv = spec.get("argv", [])
jar = next((a for a in argv if a.endswith(".jar")), None)
assert jar and os.path.exists(jar), f"java kernel jar missing: {jar}"
print(f"java kernelspec OK: {jar}")
PY'
